top_signals.title: Fraudsters steal $6 million from Tectonic crypto platform after inflating token price
top_signals.summary: At least $6 million was stolen from crypto platform Tectonic after an attacker manipulated the price of the Tonic coin over the weekend.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
